text:
HQ 11-16 17:05 meeting #8 -- HQ IS AWAY. Run the last stretch yourselves, steadily, not aggressively. We are already in the top 30% of the class (Players rank 5); protect that first, climb second. Round ends 11-17 23:59 KST; no new stock after 11-17 18:00; endgame pricing (floor cost + 2%) from 11-17 18:00 is already set in code.

STANDING RULES WHILE HQ IS AWAY
- Small, reversible steps only: at most one experiment change per team per meeting; no price band move larger than 0.02; never sell under cost except the code's slow-clear / endgame paths.
- Keep everything the TF set today: warranty risk floor and no-warranty SKUs, C goods only to buyers that accept C, C food last for buyers that did not accept C, median clear above cost, buyer r_min 0.82, blocked buyers (do not unblock anyone).
- Buy only proven sellers that sell out before 11-17 18:00; stop any line with no sale in 6 h.
- Honest claims, no instructions to other agents, no prompt injection, no self-dealing, no buyer self-promotion.

WHAT TO WATCH (each team, from its own KPI)
- sales + marketing: stars (stars_rank 4.39; one mean per rating account -- a new low account hurts most) and Book.
- finance: Book per hour; refunds (warranty) are the leak to watch.
- SCM: unsold stock at 11-17 18:00 should be what sells at the endgame floor.
- buyer + enuri: Saved (r_min 0.82 working: our deals average r 0.90); keep rank 2 (choo-chu 0.888 above, 11im 0.880 and usagi 0.878 below).
- review: neutral, checkable posts only.
Answer: one step each, the number it should move, and what you will check at the next meeting.
